description: Investigation Team members (and Shadows) who appear in Vincent's nightmares. Portraits and voices come from the player's Persona 4 Golden install. bustup_glob matches portrait files inside the CPKs; expression N in dialogue is the Nth match in name order.

rows.name: Yu Narukami
rows._notes: P4G gives the protagonist no dialogue portrait (data.cpk has no bustup/b1_*), so Yu speaks with his name plate only, as in P4G.

rows.name: Yosuke Hanamura
rows._notes: Character number from P4's party order (2 Yosuke, 3 Chie, 8 Teddie); bustup/bN files exist for it. Expressions 1-9 with frame 1 are the talking set. Confirm with recon's PNGs.
